lines.text: The boy Samuel served the LORD before Eli, and he lay down in the temple where the ark of God was.
The LORD called Samuel three times, and each time he ran to Eli, who realized the third time that the LORD was calling.
Eli told Samuel to say, "Speak, LORD, for Your servant is listening," and the LORD came and stood there calling.
The LORD told Samuel He would judge Eli's house forever, because Eli's sons blasphemed God and Eli did not restrain Hophni.
All Israel from Dan to Beersheba knew Samuel was a prophet, and the LORD kept appearing at Bethel.
